high_level_description: The image depicts a bronze sculpture titled "The Last Three," created by the artist duo Gillie and Marc. The sculpture is located indoors, likely in a museum or gallery setting, as indicated by the clean, tiled walls and floor. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the intricate details of the sculpture. The sculpture itself is a striking representation of three northern white rhinoceroses, each in a different pose. At the bottom is a standing rhinoceros, which appears to be Sudan, the last male northern white rhinoceros. On top of him is a lying-down rhinoceros, representing Najin
